description: This file manages application update logic, including checking for updates, handling update events, and user prompts for installing updates in an Electron-based desktop app.

classes.name: UpdateState
classes.description: Class representing the update state, including version info, auto-update settings, and update checks.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs error messages related to update process.

methods.name: setupUpdates
methods.description: Initializes update checking and event handling for the Electron app.

methods.name: openChangelog
methods.description: Opens the changelog URL in the default browser, pointing to the latest version.

methods.name: quitAndInstall
methods.description: Closes the app and triggers the installation of the downloaded update.

methods.name: isLessThanOneHourFromNow
methods.description: Checks if a given date is within one hour from the current time.

methods.name: showUpdateInstallationDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog prompting the user to install the update, considering backup recency.

methods.name: checkForUpdate
methods.description: Checks for available updates, optionally triggered by user action, and handles the update process.
